meta.title: Can the Fjällräven Kånken Survive a Hurricane? (Waterproof test)
meta.description:
Ah yes, Fjällräven, or Fjallraven if you are lazy and not Swedish. Similarly the Kånken (or the Kanken, again if you are lazy and not Swedish). I am not lazy but also now Swedish, but I type all the dots out. Anyways LETS CHAT!

Ever heard of Instagram? Well me too let us party. @8thWeekday

So Fjallraven introduced a new Kanken backpack. This one is much more eco-friendly (they put tree in the name) BUT the question is does it hold up? Is it one of the best backpacks under $100? No. It's more than that. Best backpack under $150? Quite possibly, depending on your needs! The Fjallraven Tree-Kanken is interesting for many reasons, one, how it's made, two, how waterproof or water resistant it is (it's waxed cotton / canvas but without the cotton / canvas).

Today I went on a hike with this little backpack and also walked through Hurricane Ida unbeknown to me. How did it hold up! How waterproof is it! How eco friendly and sustainable is the backpack? Find out!
